label: INTENTION_2, as conscious purpose: Acting with INTENTION_2 in the everyday sense: acting for an end…
definition: Acting with intention in the everyday sense: acting for an end that the agent itself knows and wills.
note: Recorded for contrast only. Reading the quinta via's dichotomy 'by chance or by intention' in this sense would already assume a knower; the case uses the broad sense instead (DEF-INTENTIO-AS-TENDING).
